name: Kamishiro Akito
source:
The next temporary head of the Kamishiro family. He seems elegant in manner, kind, and polite at first glance, but... He unquestioningly believes in the Kamishiro family's "curse."

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201021083422/https://sites.google.com/site/xmonoh/characters]Monochrome Heaven[/url]]
